description: This file contains the server-side logic for the SetExam page of the Online Examination System, including event handlers for UI interactions such as selecting courses and semesters, adding questions, and setting exams. It interfaces with a SQL database to insert and retrieve quiz questions and exam details.

classes.name: SetExam
classes.description: Partial class representing the code-behind for the SetExam ASP.NET page, handling user interactions and database operations related to setting up exams and questions.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event, initializes components if necessary.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the AdminPanel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the AdminQueue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the AdminLeaderboard page.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates the course dropdown based on the selected semester.

methods.name: clearB_Click
methods.description: Clears all input fields related to questions and exam details.

methods.name: AddQB_Click
methods.description: Adds a new MCQ question to the database and updates the question number.

methods.name: setB_Click
methods.description: Sets up an exam entry in the database for the selected course.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates course options based on the selected semester.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Retrieves and updates the question number for the selected course.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the login page, logging out.
